stem: A moisture sensor reports acceptable values, but hand checks and plant response consistently disagree at another part of the container. What is the strongest next step?
choices: Evaluate sensor placement and spatial moisture variation before treating one reading as representative
Trust the sensor location as the whole container by definition
Increase irrigation until every reading is maximal
rationale: Root-zone moisture can be spatially heterogeneous. Sensor placement must represent the zone being managed, and conflicting observations warrant investigation.
